acceptance_checkpoint.drafter: built-in DSpark (mtp.0-2, dspark_block_size 5, Markov head), vendor inference/model.py

acceptance_method.acceptance: Row p drafts d1..d5 for tok[p+2..p+6] (the main model's greedy tokens); a = leading matches; committed = a + 1. tau_walk replays a greedy speculative decode exactly (start at the first decode position, advance by a + 1; only full-depth cycles), so it is the tau a lossless greedy DSpark server would see on these continuations. tau_rows averages every full-depth position.
acceptance_method.phase_a: Greedy decode of the main model with the vendor inference/model.py modules (Block, Attention, Compressor, Indexer, Engram, Gate, hc_*) verbatim; its six tilelang kernels replaced by torch equivalents written from kernel.py (quantizers exact: fp8 e4m3 per-32 ue8m0 activations, fp4 e2m1 RNE; fp8/fp4 GEMMs dequantize both operands exactly to bf16 and accumulate in fp32 -- only the summation order differs; sparse_attn same math incl. the sink and bf16 P, without the online rescaling). Layer-streamed on a shared GPU: non-expert weights resident in pinned host RAM, the routed experts each step pread from the safetensors shards (only those the batch routes to), Engram rows pread per lookup. Each trace keeps its own vendor decode caches (window ring, compressor state, compressed KV, index keys) and runs attention at its own position (bsz 1); the MoE runs over all traces' tokens. Prefill is one chunk per prompt (start_pos 0), then one token per step (the vendor decode path).
acceptance_method.phase_b: DSpark via the vendor Transformer.forward_spec: seeded with the prompt's DSpark inputs at start_pos 0, then called at every generated position p with the verified token tok[p+1] and main_hidden[p] (the attention input of layers 37, 38, 39, mean over the hc copies, recorded in phase A), temperature 0 (argmax, greedy Markov chain).

denominator: draft + causal verify + accepted commit/rejected rollback + uncovered control/transport
numerator: accepted draft prefix plus one target token, per actual speculative walk
